info.title: Schautrack API
info.summary: Read and write your Schautrack calorie, weight, todo, and food data.
info.description:
The Schautrack public API.

## Authentication

Every endpoint except `/openapi.json` requires a **personal access token**,
sent as a bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer stk_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

Create one under **Settings → API tokens**. The token is shown once and cannot be
retrieved again. Tokens can be scoped and given an expiry, and can be revoked at
any time.

Session cookies are **not** accepted here. Because the API never treats a cookie
as authentication, no cross-site request can carry credentials to it — which is
why there is no CSRF token to manage.

## Scopes

A token carries an explicit set of scopes. A `:write` scope implies the
matching `:read`, so `entries:write` alone is enough to both read and
write entries.

Calling an endpoint without its scope returns `403` with a
`required_scope` field naming what is missing.

## Errors

Errors are [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) problem details,
served as `application/problem+json`:

```json
{
  "type": "https://schautrack.com/problems/validation-failed",
  "title": "Validation failed",
  "status": 422,
  "detail": "One or more macro values are out of range.",
  "instance": "/api/v1/entries",
  "invalid_params": [{ "name": "protein_g", "reason": "must be between 0 and 999" }]
}
```

Branch on `type`, not on `detail`: the type URI is stable, the prose is not.

## Dates and time zones

Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` in the **account's** time zone. Omitting a date means
"today" for that account, not for the machine making the request. Timestamps are
RFC 3339 UTC; each entry also carries `local_time` rendered in the account's
zone.

## Pagination

`GET /entries` and `GET /weight` are paginated by keyset. Pass the
`next_cursor` from a response back as `cursor` to fetch the next
page; stop when `has_more` is false. Cursors are opaque — do not
construct them.

## Retrying safely

Every `PUT` here is idempotent by construction: the URL names the resource
and the body states the desired state, so repeating one changes nothing.

`POST` is different. If a request to create an entry times out, you cannot
know whether it landed. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header — any string you
generate once per logical operation and reuse when retrying:

```
Idempotency-Key: 5f8c1e2a-meal-breakfast-2026-08-05
```

The first request executes and its response is stored. Any retry with the same
key replays that response, with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, instead of
logging the meal twice. Reusing a key with a *different* body returns `409`
rather than silently discarding the new request. Keys are remembered for 24
hours.

## Rate limits

Two limits apply: one per IP address and one per token. Exceeding either
returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header giving the number of
seconds until the window reopens. Honour it rather than retrying blindly.

| Scope | Grants |
| --- | --- |
| `entries:read` | Read calorie entries and their macros. |
| `entries:write` | Create, update, and delete calorie entries. |
| `weight:read` | Read weight entries. |
| `weight:write` | Record and delete weight entries. |
| `todos:read` | Read todos and their completion state. |
| `todos:write` | Create, update, delete, and complete todos. |
| `foods:read` | Read saved foods. |
| `foods:write` | Create, update, and delete saved foods. |
| `notes:read` | Read daily notes. |
| `notes:write` | Write daily notes. |
| `plan:read` | Read the weight-loss plan, its goal, and its projections. |

Completion.description: A todo's completion state on a date.

completed.description: `true` marks it done on this date, `false` clears it.

calories.description: Energy in kilocalories. May be negative to record a correction.

date.description: The day this entry belongs to, in the account's time zone.

local_time.description: `created_at` rendered as HH:MM in the account's time zone.

name.description: What was eaten. Up to 120 bytes.

EntryInput.description: A new calorie entry. Supply `calories`, at least one macro, or both.

date.description: Defaults to today in the account's time zone.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Opaque — do not parse.

EntryPatch.description: Fields to change. Omit a field to leave it alone; send `null` to clear a macro or the name.

calories.description: Energy in kilocalories. Rejected while the account computes calories from macros.

date.description: Move the entry to another day.

Macros.description: Macronutrients in grams. `null` means the macro was not recorded, which is distinct from a recorded zero.

today.description: Today's date in the account's time zone.

token.description: The token that authenticated this request.

expires_at.description: When it stops working. `null` means never.

name.description: The label given when it was created.

user.description: The account this token belongs to.

timezone.description: IANA time zone. Determines what `today` and every bare date mean.

weight_unit.description: The unit weight readings are stored in.

content.description: The note. Empty when no note is set.

updated_at.description: When it was last written (UTC). `null` when there is no note.

NoteInput.description: The note's full content. Writing an empty string deletes it.

Plan.description: The weight-loss plan: body metrics, active goal, computed budget, projected curve, and trend analysis. Weight-valued fields are in the account's unit.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced it.

required_scope.description: Present on 403s: the scope the token is missing.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

type.description: Stable URI identifying the problem type. Branch on this.

emoji.description: Optional emoji shown next to the name.

name.description: Food name. Unique per account, case-insensitively.

use_count.description: How many units have been tracked from this food.

name.description: Food name, up to 80 bytes. Must be unique for the account.

SavedFoodPatch.description: Fields to change. `null` clears a nullable field.

type.description: `daily` every day; `weekly` on the listed days.

time_of_day.description: Optional HH:MM the todo is due at.

TodoDay.description: A todo as it applies to one date.

completed.description: Whether it is done on this date.

missed_since.description: The first scheduled day missed, if the streak is broken.

streak.description: Consecutive scheduled days completed, ending on this date.

time_of_day.description: HH:MM it is due at, if set.

data.description: Timed todos first, in time order, then untimed.

name.description: What to do. Up to 100 bytes.

date.description: Defaults to today in the account's time zone.

Weight.description: A weight reading. One per account per day.

date.description: The day this reading belongs to.

unit.description: The account's weight unit. Readings are stored as entered and never converted.

weight.description: The reading, in the account's unit.

WeightList.description: A page of weight readings, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Opaque — do not parse.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token from Settings → API tokens. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer stk_…`.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed — unparseable JSON, an unknown field, or a bad query parameter.

Conflict.description: The request collides with existing state — a duplicate name, a limit already reached, or a feature not enabled.

InsufficientScope.description: The token is valid but lacks the scope this endpoint requires. The `required_scope` field names it.

NotFound.description: No such resource, or it belongs to another account.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. The `Retry-After` header gives the number of seconds until the window reopens.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or the token is unknown, revoked, or expired.

Unprocessable.description: The request is well-formed but its values are rejected. `invalid_params` lists the offending fields.
